description: Queue a read of the giveaway's comments for a running giveaway and return at once (full: true reads every comment again; slot reads one post only). Reads are limited to one every 30 seconds.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

slot.description: Read this post of the giveaway only (1 is the first)

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: giveaway_sync
title: Read the comments now
